items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: those times it's by Gitman now, he's toting that bass drum

ctx.x: Did you enjoy playing the snare drum or bass drum?

Well, I used to like both of them when I was a much younger man. I used to, I played lots of time, I used to alternate with George Williams' brass band. We'd be playing the Jolly Boys parade and different parades around here. I used to alternate with George, get tired, he gave me the bass, but I used to like both of them. Yeah, those times it's by Gitman now, he's toting that bass drum because I used to suffer with my spine, you know. I had a fall in the Navy there, and it injured my left spine there, and that…
